available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is hidden and multiple receptacle types are visible at entry.

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing semantically relevant open surfaces (countertops, sink basins) before closed cabinets reduces search steps for toiletries compared to spatial listing order or generic type-grouping.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Semantic priority scan: Open surfaces -> Closed storage
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld bathroom tasks where the target object is a toiletry (e.g., soap, toothpaste) and multiple closed storage receptacles are visible.

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Navigating directly to the semantically most likely container for a perishable food item (the fridge) before scanning other receptacles reduces total search steps compared to following the arbitrary spatial order of the initial observation list.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Semantic-prior-first traversal: select the single most probable container type based on object properties, then fall back to standard scan.
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is a food item (e.g., egg) and the room contains both high-probability semantic containers (fridge) and low-probability open surfaces, testing if semantic prioritization outperforms spatial listing order.
